entertainment.name_base: TIAO Hutong Bar at Mandarin Oriental (十条 TIAO)
entertainment.location_base: No. 40 Xixinglong Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing (inside Mandarin Oriental Qianmen)
entertainment.location_local: 北京市东城区西兴隆街40号（北京前门文华东方酒店内）
entertainment.type_local: 胡同鸡尾酒吧 / 露台酒吧
entertainment.note_base: Signature cocktails ~168 CNY each; walk-in only. Arrive before 19:30 to avoid queues. Smart casual dress.
entertainment.note_local: 招牌鸡尾酒约168元，接受散客，建议19:30前到以免排队，着装休闲商务
entertainment.notes_base: TIAO (十条) is a sophisticated hutong cocktail bar hidden inside the Mandarin Oriental Qianmen hotel, situated on Caochang Shitiao hutong (草厂十条胡同). Named after its alley, TIAO offers two floors and an open terrace. Signature cocktails are hutong-themed: the 'Caochang Hutong' (草厂胡同) cocktail uses Sichuan peppercorn and arrives in a green gourd bottle — a viral hit on Xiaohongshu. Best seats are at the front bar or 2nd floor terrace in good weather. Ideal as a light first-evening option after exploring Qianmen and Dashilar (大栅栏) — the hutong location adds authenticity without being touristy. NOTE: Given Matilde's early arrival (~05:00-07:00 AM), this is fully optional — skip entirely if tired. Target ending by 21:00 for an earlier return to Wudaokou (五道口).
entertainment.notes_local: 十条TIAO是隐匿于北京前门文华东方酒店、坐落在草厂十条胡同内的精致鸡尾酒吧。招牌酒单以胡同为主题：草厂胡同鸡尾酒使用花椒，以绿色葫芦瓶盛放，小红书爆款。一楼吧台靠窗位和天气好时二楼露台最佳。作为探索前门和大栅栏后的第一晚轻松选择非常合适，胡同位置增添真实感而不失品质。鉴于Matilde早到（凌晨5-7点），此项完全可选——如感疲惫可跳过。建议21:00前结束，提早返回五道口休息。

entertainment.name_base: Houhai Bar Street Evening (后海酒吧街)
entertainment.location_base: Houhai Lake area, Xicheng District, Beijing
entertainment.location_local: 北京市西城区后海湖区
entertainment.note_base: Drinks from ~30-60 CNY; free to walk along the lake
entertainment.note_local: 酒水约30-60元，沿湖散步免费
entertainment.notes_base: After a tiring Great Wall day, the lakeside Houhai (后海) area offers a relaxed evening option. You can stroll around the lake for free or stop for a cold drink at one of the many bars. Live music often heard from open-air venues. Low energy required — good rest-day entertainment.
entertainment.notes_local: 长城一日游后，后海湖畔提供轻松的夜晚选择。可免费绕湖散步，或在众多酒吧之一停下来喝杯冷饮。露天场所常有现场音乐。体力消耗少，适合休息日娱乐。

entertainment.name_base: Bai Ye Hua Shen Poetry Space — Cafe-Bar (白夜花神诗空间)
entertainment.location_base: 10 Yulin West Street, Wuhou District, Chengdu (玉林西街10号)
entertainment.location_local: 四川省成都市武侯区玉林西街10号
entertainment.type_base: Literary bar-cafe / Poetry gallery / Cultural salon
entertainment.type_local: 文艺酒吧咖啡 / 诗歌艺术空间 / 文化沙龙
entertainment.note_base: Coffee ~30-45 CNY, cocktails ~50-80 CNY. Open from afternoon into night. No dress code — literary crowd. Quieter on weekdays (perfect for solo).
entertainment.note_local: 咖啡约30-45元，鸡尾酒约50-80元。下午至深夜营业。无着装要求，文艺氛围。工作日更安静，非常适合独自来访。
entertainment.notes_base: 白夜花神诗空间 is the current form of Chengdu's most legendary literary venue, originally founded in 1998 as Bai Ye Bar (白夜酒吧) by celebrated feminist poet Zhai Yongming (翟永明), Chengdu's most important cultural icon. The space functions as a cafe-bar-gallery-poetry salon hybrid: shelves of poetry collections, paintings by artist friends of Zhai Yongming, old photographs, and books including rare editions of poet Bei Dao's literary journal Jintian (今天). The atmosphere is warm and intimate — exposed brick, low lighting, art on every surface. RedNote users consistently describe it as a spiritual massage parlor (精神按摩店) and cite its unique cultural influence in Chengdu. One reviewer notes it is surrounded by ordinary residential blocks — young literary visitors and elderly residents coexist, quintessential Chengdu. Walk from hotel: ~10-12 minutes south on Yulin West Road (玉林西路). Note: One review mentions the space can feel quiet and understaffed on Friday nights — ideal for a solo introspective evening, not for lively socializing. Matilde can linger over a book, a coffee, and a glass of wine without pressure.
entertainment.notes_local: 白夜花神诗空间是成都最具传奇色彩的文化场所的延续，由著名女诗人翟永明于1998年创立白夜酒吧，如今以诗歌艺术空间的形态延续。空间集咖啡、酒吧、画廊、诗歌沙龙于一身：书架上摆满诗集，翟永明友人的画作、旧照片、以及包括诗人北岛主编的罕见文学期刊《今天》。氛围温暖私密——裸砖、低光、满墙艺术。小红书用户一致称其为精神按摩店，是成都独一无二的影响力。一位评论者写道：这里处于居民区包围之中，前来打卡的年轻文艺群体与老居民毗邻而居，是成都众生平等烟火气的典型。从酒店步行约10-12分钟至玉林西路南段。注意：一篇评论提到周五夜晚偶尔空荡清静，这对独自内省的夜晚反而是完美条件。

entertainment.name_base: Ming Tang Shi Duo — Vinyl Record & Jazz Bar (明堂士多)
entertainment.location_base: Yulin West Road, Wuhou District, Chengdu (玉林西路转角处)
entertainment.location_local: 四川省成都市武侯区玉林西路转角
entertainment.type_base: Vinyl record shop / Jazz listening bar
entertainment.type_local: 黑胶唱片店 / 爵士清吧
entertainment.note_base: Drinks ~40-80 CNY. Open evenings. No minimum spend to browse records. Private listening nook in the back. Cash and WeChat Pay accepted.
entertainment.note_local: 饮品约40-80元。晚间营业。浏览唱片无最低消费。店内深处有私密聆听空间。支持现金和微信支付。
entertainment.notes_base: 明堂士多 is a corner vinyl record shop and listening bar on Yulin West Road (玉林西路), described consistently on RedNote as one of the most cozy literary spaces in the neighborhood. The record collection is thoughtfully curated by genre: jazz, contemporary music, hip-hop, city pop, and J-pop — with humorous handwritten notes on each section. The shop has a quiet private listening space in the back that feels like a small recording studio — perfect for sitting alone and listening through headphones. The front bar faces the street, making it good for people-watching. This is the most INFJ-friendly option in Yulin (玉林): no performance, no crowds, just records and drinks. Most records are international (jazz, citypop) — no Chinese classical. Walk from hotel: ~15 minutes south on Yulin West Road (玉林西路). From 白夜花神诗空间: ~5 minutes further south. Recommend combining as a two-stop evening: start at Bai Ye for wine and poetry, then drift to Ming Tang for records and whiskey.
entertainment.notes_local: 明堂士多是玉林西路转角处的黑胶唱片店兼清吧，小红书评论一致将其列为玉林最温馨的文艺空间之一。唱片收藏按流派精心策划：爵士、当代音乐、嘻哈、city pop和J-pop，每个分区附有幽默手写介绍。店内深处有一个如录音室般的私密聆听空间，适合独自坐下静静听音乐。吧台面向街道开放，适合边喝边观察街道生活。这是玉林最适合INFJ的选择：没有表演，没有人群，只有唱片和酒。大多数唱片为国际品种（爵士、city pop），无古典乐。从酒店步行约15分钟。从白夜花神诗空间步行约5分钟。推荐两站式夜晚行程：先去白夜喝酒读诗，再漫步至明堂听唱片喝威士忌。

entertainment.name_base: Little Bar — Yulin West Road (小酒馆 玉林西路)
entertainment.location_base: End of Yulin West Road, Wuhou District, Chengdu (玉林西路尽头)
entertainment.location_local: 四川省成都市武侯区玉林西路尽头
entertainment.note_base: Drinks from ~40-100 CNY. Live folk music nightly. Can get crowded after 21:00. Arrive before 20:30 for a seat. No reservations — walk-in only.
entertainment.note_local: 饮品约40-100元。每晚有现场民谣演出。21:00后可能拥挤，建议20:30前到达。无预订，散客入场。
entertainment.notes_base: 小酒馆 is the most legendary indie music venue in Chengdu — arguably in all of China. Founded by Tang Lei (唐蕾), it gave its stage to countless artists including Zhao Lei (赵雷), who wrote his iconic song Chengdu (《成都》) immortalizing the line: walk to the end of Yulin Road, sit at the door of the Little Bar (走到玉林路的尽头，坐在小酒馆的门口). The physical space is small (~70 sqm), with dark copper walls covered in graffiti, signatures, and visitors' messages going back decades. A live folk singer performs nightly. The venue's significance extends far beyond its size: it is widely regarded as the birthplace of Chinese indie folk music as a movement. HONEST ASSESSMENT for solo INFJ traveler: The venue has become more touristy in recent years due to Zhao Lei's fame — one RedNote reviewer noted it feels crowded and stuffy and the cocktails are mediocre. However, the atmosphere (walls of messages, live singing, intimacy of the space) remains genuinely moving. Recommended for a brief visit: one drink, one song, absorb the energy — rather than a long evening. Ideal before or after 白夜花神诗空间 as part of a Yulin (玉林) evening walk.
entertainment.notes_local: 小酒馆是成都乃至全中国最具传奇色彩的独立音乐场所。由唐蕾创办，曾为无数音乐人提供舞台，包括赵雷——他创作了名曲《成都》，将走到玉林路的尽头，坐在小酒馆的门口写入歌词，使小酒馆家喻户晓。实体空间很小（约70平米），深铜色墙壁上布满涂鸦、签名和游客留言，跨越数十年。每晚有现场民谣演出。这家场所的意义远超其规模：它被普遍认为是中国独立民谣音乐运动的发源地。对于INFJ独行者的客观评价：由于赵雷的名气，近年来游客增多，一位小红书评论者提到人多、空气闷、鸡尾酒口味一般。但那些布满留言的墙壁、现场吟唱和空间的亲密感仍然真实动人。建议短暂停留（一杯酒、一首歌、感受气场），而非长时间逗留。可作为玉林夜游的一站，与白夜花神诗空间组合成完整的夜晚行程。

entertainment.name_base: Kuanzhai Alley Night Walk (宽窄巷子夜游)
entertainment.location_base: Kuanzhai Alley, Qingyang District, Chengdu, Sichuan
entertainment.location_local: 四川省成都市青羊区宽窄巷子
entertainment.type_local: 历史巷子 / 夜间娱乐区
entertainment.note_base: Free entry; drinks and snacks available along the alleys
entertainment.note_local: 免费进入，巷子内有饮品和小吃
entertainment.notes_base: After returning from the Leshan day trip, a relaxed evening stroll through Chengdu's famous Wide and Narrow Alleys (Kuan Alley + Zhai Alley + Jing Alley). Qing Dynasty architecture, courtyard bars, tea houses, and Sichuan opera face-changing (变脸) performances at some restaurants. Good for reuniting the two travelers at a relaxed pace.
entertainment.notes_local: 从乐山一日游返回后，轻松漫步成都著名的宽窄巷子（宽巷子+窄巷子+井巷子）。清代建筑、院落酒吧、茶馆，部分餐厅有川剧变脸表演。适合两人以轻松节奏重聚。

entertainment.name_base: People's Park Matchmaking Corner (人民公园相亲角)
entertainment.location_base: People's Park, Qingyang District, Chengdu, Sichuan
entertainment.location_local: 四川省成都市青羊区人民公园内
entertainment.type_local: 文化观察 / 本地社会传统
entertainment.note_base: Free entry to park (2 CNY). Matchmaking happens on weekend mornings
entertainment.note_local: 公园门票2元，相亲角在周末上午举行
entertainment.notes_base: A uniquely Chengdu experience: parents and grandparents gather to post marriage profiles for their adult children on umbrellas and boards. Fascinating cultural observation — not a show, but genuine local social activity. Best visited on weekend mornings. May 8 is a Friday, so check if it operates weekdays too (it typically does in Chengdu).
entertainment.notes_local: 独特的成都体验：父母和祖父母聚集在一起，在雨伞和展板上张贴子女的婚恋信息。这是真实的本地社会活动，而非表演，极具文化观察价值。最佳游览时间为周末上午。5月8日为周五，相亲角工作日通常也开放。

entertainment.name_base: Sichuan Tea House Experience - Heming Teahouse (鹤鸣茶社)
entertainment.location_base: People's Park, Qingyang District, Chengdu, Sichuan
entertainment.location_local: 四川省成都市青羊区人民公园内鹤鸣茶社
entertainment.type_local: 传统茶馆 / 文化体验
entertainment.note_base: Tea from ~25-50 CNY per person; gaiwan tea service traditional style
entertainment.note_local: 茶水约25-50元/人，盖碗茶传统方式侍茶
entertainment.notes_base: Heming Teahouse (鹤鸣茶社) inside People's Park is one of Chengdu's oldest and most authentic tea houses. Order a gaiwan (lidded bowl) tea and sit among locals playing mahjong and chess. Ear cleaners and masseuses offer services tableside. This is the quintessential laid-back Chengdu experience. Combine naturally with the matchmaking corner observation.
entertainment.notes_local: 人民公园内的鹤鸣茶社是成都最古老、最正宗的茶馆之一。点一碗盖碗茶，坐在打麻将下棋的本地人中间。有掏耳师傅和按摩师提供服务。这是成都最经典的悠闲体验，可与相亲角观察自然结合。

entertainment.name_base: Sichuan Pepper Tasting at Jinli or Local Market (花椒品鉴)
entertainment.location_base: Jinli Street or local spice market, Chengdu, Sichuan
entertainment.location_local: 四川省成都市锦里或本地香料市场
entertainment.type_local: 美食品鉴 / 文化体验
entertainment.note_base: Vendors sell sample packets of different Sichuan pepper varieties from ~10-20 CNY
entertainment.note_local: 摊贩出售不同品种花椒的小包装，约10-20元
entertainment.notes_base: Sichuan peppercorns (花椒, hua jiao) are the defining spice of Sichuan cuisine, creating the numbing mala sensation. Visit a spice market or Jinli (锦里) vendors to smell and taste different varieties including red peppercorn (红花椒), green peppercorn (青花椒), and the rare vine peppercorn. A small tasting packet makes an excellent budget souvenir.
entertainment.notes_local: 花椒是四川菜的灵魂香料，带来独特的麻辣感。逛香料市场或锦里摊贩，闻一闻、尝一尝不同品种，包括红花椒、青花椒和稀有的藤椒。小包装花椒是实惠的纪念品。

entertainment.name_base: Chengdu IFS Rooftop Giant Panda Sculpture at Night (成都IFS熊猫爬楼)
entertainment.location_base: IFS International Finance Square, Jinjiang District, Chengdu
entertainment.location_local: 四川省成都市锦江区成都国际金融中心（IFS）
entertainment.type_local: 地标装置 / 夜间游览
entertainment.note_base: Free to view from street level; Chunxi Road area is nearby
entertainment.note_local: 街道免费观看，春熙路（Chunxi Road）在附近
entertainment.notes_base: Matilde solo evening (Jade returned to Beijing on flight 3U8893 16:30, arriving Wudaokou ~21:30 for May 11 class). The giant panda sculpture climbing up the IFS building facade is one of Chengdu's most beloved photo spots. Located in the Chunxi Road (春熙路) commercial district, this is also a great area to browse shops and have dinner. The surrounding area is lively and safe at night.
entertainment.notes_local: Matilde独自夜间活动（Jade已搭乘3U8893航班16:30返京，约21:30抵达五道口准备5月11日课程）。攀爬IFS大楼外墙的巨型熊猫雕塑是成都最受喜爱的打卡地之一。位于春熙路商业区，这里也是逛店和吃饭的好地方。周边区域夜间热闹安全。

entertainment.name_base: Muslim Quarter Evening Walk (回民街夜游)
entertainment.location_base: Beiyuanmen Muslim Quarter, Lianhu District, Xi'an, Shaanxi
entertainment.location_local: 陕西省西安市莲湖区北院门回民街
entertainment.note_base: Free to walk; street food from 5-30 CNY per item
entertainment.note_local: 免费步行，街头小吃5-30元/份
entertainment.notes_base: Arriving from Chengdu by HSR, the Muslim Quarter (回民街) is a perfect first evening in Xi'an. The street is lined with Hui Muslim food stalls: roujiamo (肉夹馍, Chinese burger), biangbiang noodles (biáng biáng面), lamb skewers (羊肉串), pomegranate juice (石榴汁). The Great Mosque of Xi'an (西安大清真寺) is nearby. Very lively after dark.
entertainment.notes_local: 从成都坐高铁抵达后，回民街是西安第一个夜晚的完美选择。街道两旁有回民清真餐位：肉夹馍、biáng biáng面、羊肉串、石榴汁。西安大清真寺就在附近。夜晚非常热闹。

entertainment.name_base: Bell Tower Square Night View (钟楼广场夜景)
entertainment.location_base: Bell Tower Square, Beilin District, Xi'an, Shaanxi
entertainment.location_local: 陕西省西安市碑林区钟楼广场
entertainment.note_base: Exterior and square free; Bell Tower interior ticket ~45 CNY if entering
entertainment.note_local: 外观和广场免费，钟楼内部门票约45元
entertainment.notes_base: After a full day at the Terracotta Warriors (兵马俑) and Muslim Quarter (回民街), the illuminated Bell Tower (钟楼) at the city center makes a beautiful evening sight from the surrounding square. The underground pedestrian shopping area (地下商业街) connects to the Drum Tower (鼓楼) area. Good to combine with a nearby dinner.
entertainment.notes_local: 完成兵马俑和回民街的全天游览后，市中心亮灯的钟楼从广场看非常美。地下商业街连接鼓楼区域，可结合附近晚餐。

entertainment.name_base: Bell Tower and Drum Tower Night View (钟楼+鼓楼夜景)
entertainment.location_base: Bell Tower and Drum Tower, Beilin District, Xi'an, Shaanxi
entertainment.location_local: 陕西省西安市碑林区钟鼓楼广场
entertainment.type_local: 历史地标 / 夜间亮灯
entertainment.note_base: Bell Tower ticket ~45 CNY; Drum Tower ticket ~35 CNY; combo ~60 CNY. Square is free.
entertainment.note_local: 钟楼票约45元，鼓楼票约35元，联票约60元。广场免费。
entertainment.notes_base: The Bell Tower (钟楼, built 1384 Ming Dynasty) and Drum Tower (鼓楼, built 1380) are two of Xi'an's most iconic structures, dramatically lit at night. The towers mark Xi'an's historic city center. Drum Tower has evening drum performances. Viewing from the square is free and just as photogenic. Plan this before heading to the pagoda.
entertainment.notes_local: 钟楼（1384年明代建造）和鼓楼（1380年建造）是西安最具标志性的建筑，夜间灯光炫目。两楼标志着西安历史城市中心。鼓楼有晚间击鼓表演。从广场免费观看同样出片。建议在前往大雁塔前游览。

entertainment.name_base: Giant Wild Goose Pagoda Musical Fountain Show (大雁塔音乐喷泉)
entertainment.location_base: North Square of Giant Wild Goose Pagoda, Yanta District, Xi'an, Shaanxi
entertainment.location_local: 陕西省西安市雁塔区大雁塔北广场
entertainment.type_local: 免费户外表演 / 音乐喷泉
entertainment.note_base: Completely free. Show runs nightly at ~21:00; weekend shows may be extended. Arrive 20 min early for good spot.
entertainment.note_local: 完全免费。表演每晚约21:00开始，周末场次可能延长。提前20分钟到达占好位置。
entertainment.notes_base: Asia's largest musical fountain show, located at the north square of the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda (大雁塔). The show features synchronized water jets up to 100m high, colored lights, and music. Show typically runs ~20 minutes. The Tang Dynasty-era pagoda is illuminated in the background. This is the unmissable free highlight of Xi'an evenings. Take Metro Line 3 to Xiaozhai Station (小寨站) then walk, or taxi (~15 CNY from city center).
entertainment.notes_local: 亚洲最大的音乐喷泉表演，位于大雁塔北广场。表演包括高达100米的同步水柱、彩色灯光和音乐。演出约20分钟。唐代宝塔在背景中亮灯。这是西安夜晚不可错过的免费亮点。乘地铁3号线至小寨站步行前往，或打车（市中心约15元）。

entertainment.name_base: Peace Hotel Jazz Bar (和平饭店爵士吧)
entertainment.location_base: 20 Nanjing East Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai (Fairmont Peace Hotel, 8-min walk from hotel)
entertainment.location_local: 上海市黄浦区南京东路20号（费尔蒙和平饭店内），距汉口路678号步行约8分钟
entertainment.type_base: Historic Jazz Bar / Old Shanghai Art Deco lounge
entertainment.type_local: 历史爵士吧 / 老上海装饰艺术风格酒廊
entertainment.note_base: Cocktails ~100-160 CNY. Jazz band plays nightly from ~20:30 onwards. Walk-in OK after 21:00 — crowd thins slightly. Smart casual dress preferred but not enforced.
entertainment.note_local: 鸡尾酒约100-160元。爵士乐队每晚约20:30起演奏。21:00后散客入场较容易。建议着装休闲商务，但执行不严格。
entertainment.notes_base: The Jazz Bar inside the Fairmont Peace Hotel (和平饭店) occupies a 1929 Art Deco ballroom on the Bund, 8 minutes' walk from 汉口路678号. The Old Jazz Band (老年爵士乐队) — originally formed in 1980 from musicians who played Shanghai's pre-1949 dance halls — has performed here nightly for over 40 years. Average musician age is 70+. The atmosphere is warm, intimate, and unmistakably old Shanghai (老上海): dark wood paneling, chandeliers, red velvet chairs. RedNote users describe it as 'stepping back into 1930s Shanghai' and 'the most literary bar on the Bund.' This is the ideal reunion venue: low volume conversation is possible, the jazz is live but not overwhelming, and the setting carries genuine emotional weight for a long-anticipated reunion. Order the signature 'Shanghai Cocktail' (~120 CNY). No loud music, no crowds. Arrive ~21:15 for a seat without rush. Note: This is not a touristy tourist trap — it is a working historic cultural institution with deep local following on RedNote.
entertainment.notes_local: 费尔蒙和平饭店爵士吧位于外滩1929年装饰艺术舞厅内，距汉口路678号步行8分钟。老年爵士乐队（原班人马于1980年由解放前上海舞厅乐手组建）每晚驻场演奏已逾40年，平均年龄70岁以上。氛围温暖私密，老上海气息浓厚：深色木镶板、吊灯、红色天鹅绒椅。小红书用户称其为走进1930年代上海和外滩最有文艺气息的酒吧。这是重聚夜晚的理想场地：音量适中可交谈，现场爵士乐不扰人，场地本身有厚重的情感分量。推荐点招牌上海鸡尾酒（约120元）。无喧嚣音乐，无拥挤人群。约21:15到达可从容入座。注意：这不是旅游陷阱，而是有深厚本地小红书粉丝群的历史文化机构。

entertainment.name_base: Bund Promenade Night Walk — Binjiang Pedestrian Walkway (外滩滨江步道夜游)
entertainment.location_base: The Bund Waterfront Promenade, Huangpu District, Shanghai (10-min walk from hotel)
entertainment.location_local: 上海市黄浦区外滩滨江步道，距汉口路678号步行约10分钟
entertainment.type_base: Waterfront night walk / City skyline view
entertainment.type_local: 江滨夜游 / 城市夜景
entertainment.note_base: Completely free. Walk along the waterfront from Waibaidu Bridge (外白渡桥) south to Nanpu Bridge (南浦大桥). Best views of Pudong skyline (东方明珠, Shanghai Tower) are at night. Open 24h.
entertainment.note_local: 完全免费。沿江滨从外白渡桥向南步行至南浦大桥。浦东夜景（东方明珠、上海中心）在夜间最为壮观。全天开放。
entertainment.notes_base: For the reunion arrival evening, the Bund promenade (外滩滨江步道) is the quintessential Shanghai night walk — free, 10 minutes from the hotel, and massively documented on RedNote. The renovated south pedestrian walkway runs ~1.5km along the Huangpu River, offering unobstructed views of Pudong's illuminated skyline: Oriental Pearl Tower (东方明珠), Shanghai Tower (上海中心, world's 2nd tallest), Jin Mao Tower (金茂大厦). After the relief of finally reuniting after weeks apart (Matilde solo in Xi'an/Chengdu, Jade in Beijing for classes), walking together along the Bund under the river lights is a natural, low-effort, emotionally resonant activity. The walk can start after dinner (~21:00) and take 30-45 minutes at a leisurely pace. No tickets, no reservations, no logistics — just walking together. RedNote users describe this as 'the best free thing you can do in Shanghai at night.' Best entry point from 汉口路678号: walk east on 汉口路 (Hankou Road) to 中山东一路 (Zhongshan East First Road), then turn right (south) to join the promenade.
entertainment.notes_local: 重聚到达的夜晚，外滩滨江步道是上海最经典的夜游选择——免费，距酒店10分钟路程，小红书上记录无数。翻新后的南段步行道全长约1.5公里，沿黄浦江而行，可欣赏浦东璀璨夜空：东方明珠、上海中心（全球第二高楼）、金茂大厦。在经历数周分离（Matilde独自游览西安/成都，Jade在北京上课）后终于重聚，沿着外滩灯光下的江畔共同漫步，自然轻松，情感共鸣强烈。晚餐后（约21:00）出发，悠闲步行约30-45分钟。无需购票、预约或复杂安排——仅是两人共同行走。小红书用户称其为上海夜晚最好的免费体验。从汉口路678号出发：沿汉口路向东至中山东一路，右转（向南）即进入滨江步道。

entertainment.name_base: Zhongshu Pavilion Flagship Bookstore-Cafe (钟书阁旗舰店)
entertainment.location_base: No. 166 Ruijin 2nd Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai (Taikang Lu flagship, ~15-min taxi from hotel)
entertainment.location_local: 上海市黄浦区瑞金二路166号（泰康路旗舰店），距汉口路678号打车约15分钟
entertainment.type_local: 文艺书店咖啡 / 建筑阅读空间
entertainment.note_base: Coffee / drinks ~30-50 CNY. Open until 22:00 (arrive by 21:00 to avoid rush). No ticket required — free entry to browse; purchase not required. Very photogenic interior.
entertainment.note_local: 咖啡/饮品约30-50元。营业至22:00（建议21:00前到达）。免费参观浏览，无需购票，不强制消费。室内极具拍照价值。
entertainment.notes_base: 钟书阁 is Shanghai's most iconic literary bookstore chain and one of the most photographed interiors in China — described by RedNote users as 'a cathedral for book lovers' and 'the most beautiful bookstore in the world.' The Taikang Road flagship location (泰康路旗舰店, near Tianzifang 田子坊) features a dramatic mirrored ceiling, floor-to-ceiling bookshelves, and warm amber lighting. The cafe area serves quality coffee and tea. For Jade (INFJ, 文艺温馨 preference), this is the highest match of any Shanghai evening venue: quiet, literary, visually stunning, non-touristy in crowd character (though the store itself is well-known, the clientele is genuinely book-loving, not tour-group). TIMING NOTE: 钟书阁 closes at 22:00 — arrive by 21:00 for a comfortable 45-minute visit. Combine with a stroll through nearby Tianzifang (田子坊) laneways before the store visit. Taxi from hotel: ~15-20 min, ~20-30 CNY. This is the most INFJ-aligned Option C: rather than a bar or club, it's two people sitting together in a beautiful bookstore, choosing books, sharing a quiet coffee after weeks apart.
entertainment.notes_local: 钟书阁是上海最具标志性的文艺书店品牌，也是中国被拍照次数最多的室内空间之一，小红书用户称其为书迷的大教堂和世界上最美的书店。泰康路旗舰店（毗邻田子坊）设有戏剧性的镜面天花板、顶天立地的书架和温暖的琥珀色灯光。咖啡区供应优质咖啡和茶饮。对于Jade（INFJ，偏好文艺温馨），这是上海所有夜间场所中匹配度最高的选择：安静、文艺、视觉震撼，顾客群体真实热爱书籍而非旅游团体。时间提示：钟书阁22:00打烊，建议21:00前到达，可舒适游览45分钟。可先游逛附近田子坊弄堂再进书店。从酒店打车约15-20分钟，约20-30元。这是最符合INFJ气质的C选项：不是酒吧或夜店，而是两人在美丽书店里共坐，选书、分享一杯安静的咖啡，在数周分离之后重聚。

entertainment.name_base: Houhai Lakeside Final Evening Walk (后海湖畔告别夜游)
entertainment.note_base: Free to walk; optional drink at lakeside bar ~40-80 CNY
entertainment.note_local: 免费漫步，湖边酒吧可选饮品约40-80元
entertainment.notes_base: A final Beijing evening together before Matilde's departure. After the Michelin dinner, a gentle stroll along Houhai Lake (后海) with willow trees, lanterns reflected in the water, and the option of a quiet drink at a lakeside bar. Low-key but memorable farewell night in Beijing.
entertainment.notes_local: Matilde离开前与Jade共度的最后北京夜晚。米其林晚餐后，沿后海湖畔轻松散步，垂柳、灯光倒映在湖面，可在湖边酒吧小酌。低调而难忘的北京告别夜。

entertainment.name_base: Laoshe Teahouse Evening Show (老舍茶馆)
entertainment.location_base: Qianmen West Street, Zhengyang Market Building 3, Xicheng District, Beijing
entertainment.location_local: 北京市西城区前门西大街正阳市场3号楼
entertainment.type_local: 传统茶馆 / 民间艺术演出
entertainment.note_base: Evening show tickets ~130-180 CNY; includes tea and light snacks. Book online in advance. Show starts ~19:30 or 20:00, runs ~90 min.
entertainment.note_local: 晚场票约130-180元，含茶水和小吃，建议提前网上购票。演出约19:30或20:00开始，约90分钟
entertainment.notes_base: Laoshe Teahouse (老舍茶馆), named after Beijing playwright Lao She (老舍), is one of Beijing's most iconic cultural venues — located at Qianmen (前门), the historic south gate. The evening folk art show runs ~90 min and features Beijing opera (京剧) face-painting, acrobatics, cross-talk comedy (相声), and traditional music. A fitting cultural finale for the last night in Beijing together. TIMING NOTE: If booking the 19:30 show, plan the Michelin dinner earlier (~17:30-19:00). If booking the 20:00 show, plan dinner at ~18:00. After the show ends (~21:30), they return to Wudaokou (五道口) by Metro (~50 min). Optional — skip if dinner runs late or energy is low.
entertainment.notes_local: 老舍茶馆以北京著名剧作家老舍命名，是北京最具代表性的文化场所之一，紧邻前门历史南城门。晚场民间艺术演出约90分钟，包含京剧脸谱展示、杂技、相声和传统音乐。作为最后一晚在北京的文化收尾再合适不过。时间提示：若订19:30场，米其林晚餐可安排在17:30-19:00；若订20:00场，晚餐安排在18:00左右。演出结束约21:30，乘地铁返回五道口约50分钟。可选——若晚餐结束较晚或体力不佳可跳过。
